title: Read hosted unit manifests
responsibility: Load and validate committed unit manifests at the pinned revision.

inputs.name: hubRecords.context
inputs.description: The source context passed to hubMetadata and hubRead; context.entries determines which paths are considered. Only entries matching specification/units/<filename>.json are read as unit manifests.

outputs.name: hubRecords
outputs.description: Returns the parsed manifests for matching entries after hubMetadata completes. Each entry must parse with componentManifestSchema, have a path matching its id, and have an ID unique among the loaded manifests.

errors.name: hubFail
errors.description: The hubFail() failure path is used when a candidate JSON fails schema parsing, its path does not match its parsed id, or two parsed manifests share an ID. Failures from hubMetadata, hubRead, or hubJson are not caught here and reject this async function.
